selection_no_match_rule: Do not exceed max(5%, baseline no-match injection on the same split). The 5% production release target is reported separately.
amendment: The baseline itself injects on 2 of 22 development negatives after adding hard controls. An initial absolute-5% selection rule made every additive hybrid variant inadmissible by construction; that pilot selected no candidate and automatically re-scored the baseline heldout set. No heldout outcomes informed the correction. Keep every control and require no false-positive regression for research selection. Subsequent runs replay the frozen policies to check reproducibility; they do not introduce new hypotheses after the third non-improvement.

hypotheses.description: Learned word-vector means recover conceptual matches absent from lexical candidates.
Corpus IDF weighting gives informative words more influence than common wording.
Removing the leading corpus component separates generic similarity from useful subject similarity.
Character n-gram similarity recovers morphology and partial identifiers missed by lexical admission.
Giving the canonical title four times its normal influence improves retrieval over verbose claim wording.
Routing through concise titles avoids dilution by procedural detail.

heldout_policy: Evaluate only the baseline and selected candidate after stopping; do not retune from held-out outcomes.
limitations: The existing held-out baseline was published previously. These are synthetic retrieval trials, not evidence of real agent task success or a production rollout authorization. Corpus documents are visible; held-out queries and labels are not used for selection.
